tools.name: finzdata_get
tools.description: Read-only GET request to the FinzData REST API (docs: https://finzdata.com/docs) with your key (for example /v1/prices/daily, /v1/futures/daily, /v1/gex/daily, /v1/cot, /v1/pulse/{name}, /v1/model/latest). Optionally save the result into your workspace with save_to; results over 40 KB are saved auto

tools.name: strategy_list
tools.description: List public FinzData Hub strategies (momentum, trend, mean reversion, value, factor, AI Tournament). sort: robust (deflated Sharpe), benchmark (Sharpe above its own benchmark), forward, new, forks. Each entry gives its slug, its statistics and whether it beats or trails its benchmark. Every listed s

tools.name: strategy_run
tools.description: Re-run a listed FinzData strategy exactly as published, on its full point-in-time history through end (default today), on the FinzData servers. Free on every plan. Saves spec.json and result.json to /workspace/strategies/<slug>/ unless save is false. The result has statistics, the benchmark's statis

tools.name: workspace_run
tools.description: Run a JavaScript (ES module) program inside your workspace. It must `export default async function (input) { ... }` and return JSON. Use `import { get } from "codemode:finzdata"` for data and `import fs from "node:fs/promises"` for files under /workspace. No other network access.

tools.name: workspace_write
tools.description: Write a text file in your FinzData Workspace (paths live under /workspace and persist between sessions; docs: https://finzdata.com/workspace).

tools.name: workspace_read
tools.description: Read a text file from your FinzData Workspace (docs: https://finzdata.com/workspace).

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List a directory in your FinzData Workspace (default /workspace; docs: https://finzdata.com/workspace).

tools.name: workspace_delete
tools.description: Delete a file or directory in your FinzData Workspace (a per-key file store on Cloudflare; docs: https://finzdata.com/workspace).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "workspace_run" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
